normalization_plan.reason: The newImplementation parameter only exists to carry the caller/admin supplied address into the upgrade path, so it collapses into the upgradeTo entry point.
newAdmin is purely the input of the admin transfer flow and has no standalone semantics outside changeAdmin.
The implementation parameter is only meaningful as the target of the _delegate delegatecall and should be folded into it.
local slot is a temporary alias of IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT used only inside _implementation.
local impl is the return buffer of _implementation and carries no independent state.
local adm is only the sload result returned by _admin.
local factory is only used to look up the product implementation and is scoped to _implementation.
account is the sole argument of the isContract code-size check.
local size is the transient extcodesize result inside isContract.
_logic only feeds initialization of the implementation slot in the constructor flow.
_data is only the delegatecalled initialization payload of the constructor flow.
data is the caller supplied delegatecall payload of the upgrade-and-call entry point.
newFactory is written directly into FACTORY_SLOT by _setFactory and has no other use.
success is the transient delegatecall return flag required by the upgrade-and-call flow.
